dialogue.response.work: Do you have anything that needs taking?
dialogue.response.quiet_route: Is there a quieter way through the courtyards?
dialogue.response.ask_patrol: What does the avenue patrol actually do?
dialogue.response.repairs_cover: Building repairs. Which door do staff use?
dialogue.response.pay_file: I need two pages put somewhere quieter.
dialogue.response.no_questions: I need a file. No questions.
dialogue.response.ask_directions: Which way is the tram stop?
dialogue.response.mention_vera: I may know something about Vera.
dialogue.response.just_looking: Nothing. I was only looking around.
dialogue.response.confirm_vera: Her name should go in the book.
dialogue.response.ask_deliveries: Do deliveries come through the yard?
dialogue.response.ask_caretaker: Who looks after the courtyard buildings?
dialogue.grigori.greeting: If you are waiting for someone, wait somewhere else. If you are here for me, speak.
dialogue.grigori.work: A parcel. An ordinary address. Ordinary money, if you carry it like an ordinary man.
dialogue.grigori.route: Bread comes through the service gate at six. Walk behind the handcart and the yard sees another pair of hands.
dialogue.grigori.refuse: You have been asking with your eyes. Come back when the street has forgotten you.
dialogue.vera.greeting: Do not look at the window. Look at the avenue. What do you need?
dialogue.vera.patrol: The one on the avenue turns at the bakery, not the corner. Walk behind him, never across him.
dialogue.vera.pry: Because leaving suddenly is more memorable than staying. You should understand that better than most.
dialogue.vera.refuse: Not now. You brought somebody's attention with you.
dialogue.clerk.counter: Public enquiries are the left tray. Everything else requires a reason.
dialogue.clerk.hours: The public desk closes at five. Staff leave by the boiler passage until half past six.
dialogue.clerk.staff_route: Repairs use the grey door behind the boiler room. Tell Petrov at the desk before you carry anything through.
dialogue.clerk.paid: Two pages can be filed where nobody looks. The filing fee is one hundred and thirty.
dialogue.clerk.alarm: Then you have come to the wrong building. Stand where I can see your hands while I fetch someone.
dialogue.clerk.refuse: I remember your last question. There will not be another one.
dialogue.officer.desk: State your business, or conduct it somewhere outside this station.
dialogue.officer.directions: Two blocks north, then the avenue. The tram sign is visible from the crossing.
dialogue.officer.vera: Names are not conversation. If you give me one, you will sign beneath it.
dialogue.officer.watch: People who are only looking usually look from the pavement. I will remember the coat.
dialogue.officer.refuse: We have spoken already. Leave the building.
dialogue.grocery.hello: Bread is rationed to two loaves. Questions are not rationed, unfortunately.
dialogue.grocery.hours: Six, unless the flour lorry is late. Then we close when the shelves are empty.
dialogue.grocery.delivery: The bakery cart uses the yard gate just before six. Nobody stops it; stopping bread starts arguments.
dialogue.shop.refuse: Buy something or let the next person reach the counter.
dialogue.hardware.hello: If it is not on the shelf, it is in the ledger. If it is not in the ledger, we never had it.
dialogue.hardware.caretaker: Petrov. Grey cap, bad knee. He takes tea behind the boiler room at half past five.
dialogue.hardware.pipe: Back wall, second rack. Bring the cut length here before you leave.
dialogue.mechanic.busy: Keep clear of the axle. What is it?
dialogue.mechanic.delivery: Tuesday and Friday, quarter past five. The driver leaves the service door open while he counts crates.
dialogue.mechanic.car: Bent steering arm. Owner found the kerb faster than the brake.
dialogue.mechanic.refuse: I work with machines because they do not ask that kind of question.
social.civilian.report: That citizen has called for an officer.
interaction.noticeboard.label: read the district noticeboard
interaction.noticeboard.text: Coal collection has moved to Thursdays. A handwritten line adds: yard deliveries use the service gate after six.
interaction.directory.label: inspect the office directory
interaction.directory.text: Public records are on the ground floor. Repairs and deliveries report to the staff entrance behind the building.
interaction.timetable.label: check the tram timetable
interaction.timetable.text: The six-ten changeover leaves the northern crossing unattended for several minutes.
interaction.public_door.label: open the shop door
interaction.public_door.text: The public door gives easily. Entering here looks ordinary during business hours.
interaction.staff_door.text: The latch lifts exactly as described. The rear office route is available.
interaction.car.label: inspect the parked car
interaction.car.text: The engine is still warm. A station permit is tucked behind the windscreen.
interaction.bench.label: inspect the bench
interaction.bench.text: Fresh cigarette ash and a folded racing page: somebody waits here often.
interaction.satchel.label: inspect the discarded satchel
interaction.satchel.text: Empty, except for a maintenance chit naming the boiler-house delivery entrance.
interaction.phone.label: check the telephone directory
interaction.phone.text: The public directory lists the caretaker's extension beside the records office.
interaction.pump.label: use the yard pump
interaction.pump.text: The handle complains, then cold iron-tasting water runs into the drain.
interaction.station_notice.label: read the station notice
interaction.station_notice.text: Visitors must state their business at the desk. Loitering in the entrance hall will be noted.
feedback.suspicion.falls: Your explanation seems to have settled them.
feedback.suspicion.rises: They seem less at ease with you.
feedback.suspicion.rises_sharply: They are watching you closely now.
dialogue.resident.directions: North along the avenue. Stay on this side until the crossing; the other pavement ends at the yard wall.
dialogue.resident.pry: Why would you ask me that? I do not know you.
grigori.courier_take: Take it to {place}. Do not run with it. If they stop you with that in your coat it is not a fine, it is a sentence.
grigori.diversion_bought: One bottle, one length of wire. Throw it well away from yourself.
grigori.intel_bought: My cousin sweeps the yard at the station. The routes are on this. They are correct — I do not sell guesses.
clerk.paid: Two pages go into a different folder. It costs you nothing but money. That is the expensive part.
vera.brief: The one on the avenue turns at the bakery, not the corner. Everybody gets that wrong. Walk behind him, not across.
handler.informed_vera: A name went into that building an hour ago and it was not yours. I am not going to ask. But you will notice what I send you from now on.
handler.debrief: You sat with them two hours and walked out. Nobody walks out. I have stopped assuming.
you.diversion_hit: A bottle goes over a fence two streets away. Boots turn toward it.
you.diversion_miss: The bottle lands. Nobody was close enough to care.
you.delivered: Parcel gone. ₽{pay}, and nobody wrote anything down.
prompt.fence.busy: Grigori has nothing for you until that is delivered
prompt.station.none: They have no interest in you yet
prompt.station.vera: give them Vera · −45 file · −38 confidence · she is gone
ending.clear.vera_gone: Vera was not at her window.
handler.brief.ordinary_traffic: A film cassette, taped under a bench in the park west of the avenue. Collect it and leave by the north gate. You are a man running an errand. Walk like one.
handler.now_carrying: You are carrying now. Same streets, higher price. Walk.
prompt.servicing.sub: this is conspicuous — check who is looking
loading.error: The district could not be opened. Check the console and reload.
ending.burned.title: Burned
ending.burned.body: They never caught you doing anything. They only had to keep seeing you do it.
ending.clear.title: Clear
ending.clear.confidence_high: He will send the next one within the week.
ending.clear.confidence_mid: The next tasking will be thinner.
ending.clear.confidence_low: He has started wondering who else you talk to.
